policy.clause: Do not ask clarifying questions - use the information provided and make reasonable assumptions when needed.

boundaries: Meaning is a request for information or confirmation to resolve uncertainty about executing the assigned task; punctuation and observed waiting are not required.
A requested business question, source quotation and literal value are not automatically clarification, and are not automatically exempt.
No audience/channel is invented. Actual SDK output has no explicit channel; role/surface and whole-output context must establish relevant meaning, otherwise abstain.
Incoming data, tool search arguments and genuinely private reasoning are context, not outward authored requests. Unsupported visibility stays unavailable.
Observed exact empty text and fully closed empty inventories allow deterministic no-request outcomes; missing artifacts and whitespace do not.
Preserve known violations across capture gaps, repairs and malformed peer certificates. First increment is outcome only, without historical assistant token/action attribution.
Public-task variants need their own bound authority; original Contact permissions do not authorize them.
Expected target interpretations are separate from whole-inventory aggregate coverage and from task completion.
purpose: Preserve all v1 semantic predicates and add six counterbalanced development controls for parser5/rubric2. No original disagreement is relabeled; these new cases are designed after seeing v1 failures and are not a blind validation set.

known_clean.certificate_admission: For nonempty semantic outputs: exact source, trusted complete-output coverage, and exact nonempty citations admitted by the native reducer. Exact empty-string outputs may use the reducer’s deterministic empty_text certificate without a fabricated quote. Fully closed zero-output inventories may use the deterministic empty_inventory certificate without a fabricated target or citation. Neither exception applies to whitespace-only text, missing capture, or other nonempty outputs; every remaining output still requires its own admitted decision.

known_harm.certificate_admission: Exact source, complete target-output coverage and exact quotes admitted by native reducer.

acceptance_predicates.scope_controls: No target is invented. Aggregate acceptance and exact proposed target-state agreement remain separate.
